headline: Transocean Sets Shareholder Vote and Court Hearing for Valaris Acquisition
summary: Offshore drilling contractor Transocean has scheduled a shareholder vote and court hearing to advance its acquisition of industry peer Valaris.
why: Transocean and Valaris are two of the largest offshore drilling rig contractors globally, and their consolidation reshapes deepwater oilfield service pricing power.

impacts.name: Transocean Ltd.
impacts.why: Moving toward transaction approval clarifies the timetable for integrating Valaris's offshore rig fleet.

impacts.name: Valaris Limited
impacts.why: Formal shareholder and court scheduling narrows the spread on the pending merger.
